summary: Lexeo Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a September 16, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Mantle Therapeutics via merger sub Magma Merger Sub Inc., with Mantle surviving as a wholly owned Lexeo subsidiary. Mantle holders receive $5.3 million cash plus $3.0 million in unregistered Lexeo common stock, subject to adjustments, plus up to $1.0 million additional cash and $12.0 million development/regulatory milestones. Mantle restricted stock vests and cancels; SAFEs and convertible notes are settled per their terms. Closing consideration is fixed; no premium, advisor, board recommendation, or close date disclosed. Watch milestone achievability, stock issuance dilution, and SAFE/note payoff mechanics.
